## Context

Ricardo Silva, also known as **Rica Games**, was a famous Brazilian YouTuber between 2013 and 2016, until he disappeared from the internet for eight years.

In November 2024, he was found by **REnanPlay** and **Menino Thomas**, both *Bento Carneiros*—a kind of mystical vampire capable of assuming other identities to ruin lives. Pretending to help, they gave Rica a gaming PC and support, but it was all part of a plan to control and feed on him.

In early 2025, under their influence, Rica began to isolate himself and self-destruct, while the vampires distanced themselves to appear innocent. By May, the curse was nearly complete, putting the future of Rica Games at risk.
